question: Who among the following Sikh Gurus founded the Tarn Taran Sahib?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guru Arjan Dev**__.

__
 
• **Guru Arjan Dev a Sikh Guru founded the Tarn Taran Sahib**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tarn Taran Sahib** is a city in the Majha region of the state of Punjab in northern India.

 
 
• It is the district headquarters and hosts the municipal council of Tarn Taran district.
 
• Gurdwara Sri Tarn Taran Sahib a major Sikh pilgrimage center is located in the central part of the city.
 
• Tarn Taran Sahib was founded by the fifth Sikh Guru, Sri Guru Arjan Dev (1563–1606).
 
• He established a town named Tarn Taran, it was made a district in the year 2006.
 
• The foundation of Tarn Taran Sahib Temple was laid by Guru Arjan Dev.​​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• **Guru Nanak Dev** was the founder of Sikhism.

 
 
• He was born on 15th April which is celebrated as Katak Poornamashi.
 
 
 
• **Guru Ram Das** is the fourth Guru of Sikhism.​
 
• **Guru Gobind Singh** was the tenth Sikh guru.
